openQuestions.q: What bounded existing-source namespace must Wave 1 use to decide that an ExistingTopologySourceRefV1.canonicalSourceRef is known, given that handler/dispatch/static discovery adapters are explicitly deferred to Wave 1A?
openQuestions.evidence: CHK-002 promises deterministic AT_UNKNOWN_REF for unknown canonical refs, while the approved example uses both command review_run_start and non-command symbol verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope. PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY is a flat fact catalog and the decision doc explicitly says it is not a handler/dispatch graph.
openQuestions.resolution: Wave 1 resolves existing canonicalSourceRef only against persisted Story-owner IDs using the exact prefixes acceptance-binding, checklist, intent, milestone, and evidence with deterministic composite evidence refs. Unknown prefixes or unresolved IDs produce AT_UNKNOWN_REF in observe-only output. It does not infer command, handler, dispatch, process-fact, static graph, or runtime trace sources; those remain Wave 1A discovery work.
